description: Create the generate-health-report Supabase Edge Function that aggregates user health data and generates AI insights using Gemini.
steps: Import shared utilities from ../_shared/common.ts: adminClient, body, FunctionError, invoke, requireUser, round
Accept POST body with { type: 'weekly' | 'monthly' } parameter
Calculate IST day boundaries (Asia/Kolkata, UTC+5:30) matching the pattern in chat-health-coach

For weekly reports: determine the most recent completed week (Monday-Sunday), aggregate food_logs (calories, protein, carbs, fat per day), water_logs (ml per day), weight_logs (start/end weight), pushup_sessions (verified sessions per day with rep_count), fines (amount_paise, created_at for the week)
For monthly reports: determine the most recent completed month, aggregate same data bucketed by week (Week 1-4/5)

Compute derived stats: push-up days completed, total reps, avg kcal/day, avg protein/day, most logged foods (by name frequency from detected_items jsonb), nutrition targets from users table (daily_calorie_target, daily_protein_target)
Fetch streaks from the streaks table (current_pushup_streak, longest_pushup_streak)

Call Gemini (gemini-2.5-flash via VISION_API_KEY) with structured context to generate a personalized insight text (2-3 sentences). Use responseMimeType: 'application/json' with a responseSchema for the insight field

Return structured JSON with all sections needed: header (date range, user name), top_stats, nutrition_summary, daily_trends (for chart data), pushup_log, most_logged_foods, progress_summary (weight), weekly_breakdown (monthly only), discipline_summary, insight text, and footer disclaimer
Handle edge cases: no data for a period returns zeroes, missing user profile returns defaults
acceptance_criteria: TypeScript compiles without errors under Deno (deno check)
Function uses invoke() wrapper pattern from common.ts
Function accepts type: 'weekly' | 'monthly' and validates the input
Function queries food_logs, water_logs, weight_logs, pushup_sessions, fines, streaks, and users tables
Function calls Gemini API for insight generation
Function returns comprehensive JSON matching the report design requirements
verification: Run: cd /projects/sandbox/Rapgate && deno check --config supabase/functions/deno.json supabase/functions/generate-health-report/index.ts (or equivalent Deno check)

Read the generated file and verify all table queries match the schema (food_logs.detected_items, water_logs.amount_ml, weight_logs.weight_kg, pushup_sessions.status/rep_count/started_at, fines.amount_paise/status/created_at, streaks.*, users.daily_calorie_target/daily_protein_target/name)
findings: Deno was not pre-installed in the sandbox; installed via curl. deno check passes successfully. No deno.json/import_map exists in supabase/functions/ - direct URL imports work fine. The user also requested auto-send to email which is outside scope of this feature (Edge Function creation only) and should be considered for a future feature.
